description: Bulugo helps marine fuel buyers compare market prices, plan routes, find suppliers, and request fuel quotes, while authenticated suppliers manage coverage, products, prices, leads, lubricants, contact preferences, and support through ChatGPT. Read-only market and catalogue tools can work without sign-in; account actions require Bulugo OAuth. During review, fuel RFQs run only in Bulugo's isolated authenticated sandbox and cannot contact production suppliers.
